titre.en: questions that will break ur brain at 3am

legendes.en:
some questions don't have answers. that's exactly why they're worth thinking about.

the mind, how we know anything, time, right and wrong, and why anything exists at all.

philosophers have argued about these for centuries. u get to join in.

save this for the next night u can't sleep.

#philosophy #deepthoughts #learning #curiosity #studytok
